General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the OEM Rubber Tailgate Seal for the SJ413 Soft Top Model.
This part mounts to the tailgate’s opening edge and its function is to seal the tailgate so that water can’t get in when it is closed.
This part is made to fit and requires no cutting or modifications.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Tailgate Weather Strip – Soft Top Model
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
